Focus Chinese 其賜邑子黃金百斤 follows the edict on 大司農邑 (Zhu Yi); 邑子 is Yi's son, not a son named Yi. The proposed literal restores the correct kinship reading without changing the rest of the phrasing.
At the time few could be praised for transforming and governing; only Chancellor of Jiangdu Dong Zhongshu, Imperial Household Grandee Gongsun Hong, and Ni Kuan were worth recording in office.

Focus Chinese 內史公孫弘 names Gongsun Hong as neishi (metropolitan capital superintendent), not Imperial Household Grandee. The proposed bare “Neishi” is awkward English; revise to the natural office title already used in the idiomatic line.
